Once upon a time, there was humanity,
In their prime, they thrived, strong and mighty.
They built monuments to show their prowess,
And tamed nature with their endless cause.

But as they rose, their power grew stronger,
Their greed and desire only bigger.
Ignoring all warnings that came their way,
They pushed on, heedless of what could happen tomorrow.

As pollution choked the air they breathed so clean,
Famine and war spread like wildfire between nations.
Destruction became normality, and progress was never-ending,
Their obsession with progress left them unseeing.

With no thought for anything but themselves,
The end finally came, it was just a matter of when it began.
Humanity perished in their quest for power and wealth,
Leaving nothing behind but rubble and hell.

So long humanity, may your memory remain,
May this elegy serve as a testament to your tragic end.
We will not forget the lessons you taught us,
May we rise from our ashes, forevermore, in harmony.
